rows.text: computes the element count (qword `[rcx+8]` minus qword `[rcx]`) / 0x18 and, when `edx` is above it (unsigned), calls `0020BB10(rcx, qword [rcx+8], edx - count, pointer to a zeroed 0x18-byte stack value)` and returns its result; otherwise adds to qword `[rcx+8]` the signed 0x18-byte-element distance that moves it to qword `[rcx]` + `edx` * 0x18

notes: 0019CD40 shrink path: the store is end += ((end - (begin + edx*0x18)) * 0xd555555555555555 >> 2, sign-rounded) * 0x18, i.e. end becomes begin + edx*0x18 when the distance is a multiple of 0x18; rax on that path is a by-product, so no return is stated.
